name: Grey cave hide
label: Hides
lead: Hide shaped like a solid grey stone cave with an arched entrance - a sturdy, dark shelter for snakes and lizards, ideal for the cooler side of the terrarium.

description.html: This hide looks like a solid, rounded piece of dark grey rock with a furrowed, slightly porous surface. Under the rock an arched entrance leads into a roomy interior that is dark enough to give your animal real peace.

The tall, compact shape and neutral grey color make it a good choice for snakes, as well as lizards that look for shelter during the day. The dark grey tone matches grey rocks, slate and dark substrates, and adds contrast in a light terrarium.

description.text: A hide for the cool side

description.html: On the warm side your animal digests and basks, and on the cool side it rests and cools down. To do this without stress, it needs a hide on the cool side too. A solid cave is a good choice for that spot, while a hide with a basking platform can go on the warm side.
Place it directly on the terrarium floor and fill the substrate around it so your animal cannot dig underneath. Check the inside once a week and wash it with warm water and a brush as needed.
